app_structure: - Model Task: id (uuid), nazwa (str), klient (str), adres (str), termin (str/iso), opis (str), numer_zlecenia (str), stages (dict of stage_id -> {status: 'nie_rozpoczety'|'w_trakcie'|'ukonczony', photos: list of Photo}), created_at (datetime), updated_at (datetime).
- Model Photo: id (uuid), stage_id (str), photo_url (str), description (str), author_name (str), created_at (datetime).
- GET /api/tasks -> list all tasks with summary & progress %
- GET /api/tasks/{id} -> get task detail with all stages & photos
- PATCH /api/tasks/{id}/stages/{stage_id}/status -> update stage status (open to anyone with link)
- POST /api/tasks/{id}/stages/{stage_id}/photos -> add photo with author name, description (accepts JSON with photo_url or multipart/base64)

- Create seed data in backend/seed.py with 4-5 realistic Polish WIMED road assembly projects (DK79 Piaseczno, A2 Węzeł Łódź Północ, S8 Radzymin, Obwodnica Krakowa) containing rich pre-filled stages and photos.
- '/' -> Dashboard (Tasks progress table with 4 columns: Produkcja, Pakowanie, Dostawa i rozładunek, Montaż, search, metrics, Create Task dialog)
- '/zadanie/:id' -> Public Task Detail Page (Stage workflow, manual status buttons, photo uploader with author name, photo gallery with lightbox)
- Polish language everywhere (Polski interfejs, profesjonalna terminologia montażowa i drogowa WIMED).
- Red WIMED branding palette: Primary Crimson/Rose #E11D48, dark industrial slate surfaces (#0D1117, #161B22), sharp borders, glowing accents.
